zh: 主体笔画左侧有三个分离的小型深色残片。
主体上部有一条围绕浅色开口的横向笔画。
多条斜向和竖向笔画从上部连接处向下延伸。
一条长深色分支向左下方伸出。
另一条分支向右下方伸出，并以尖端结束。
下部中央有重叠深色笔画和开放的白色间隙。
en: Three small detached dark fragments stand to the left of the main group.
The main group has an upper horizontal stroke around a pale opening.
Several diagonal and vertical strokes descend from the upper junction.
A long dark branch extends toward the lower left.
Another branch projects toward the lower right with a pointed end.
The lower center contains overlapping dark strokes and open white gaps.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
